journeys.title: Navigation & command discovery
journeys.trigger: User chooses a sidebar destination or opens app command/jump UI.
journeys.actions: Filter visible groups; move by orientation-aware arrow/Home/End; select destination or run a ranked command.
journeys.observable_outcome: Selected destination/command becomes active; filtered settings rows can be revealed and palette/dialog outcomes can be observed.
service_dependencies: App-owned destination state; optional command registry and native bridge for menu/deep-link actions.
extended_demands: command palette modal and focus trap

journeys.title: Settings navigation, editing & persistence
journeys.trigger: User opens Settings, searches for section/entry, or changes a setting.
journeys.actions: Search and select section; edit injected controls; call SettingsContext.set/patch through supplied backend.
journeys.observable_outcome: Active section and search reveal update; values save, errors surface and revisions may reject stale writes.
service_dependencies: SettingsBackend load/patch/subscribe; Tauri-backed rightkit-settings adapter in production; section-specific adapters.

journeys.title: First-run onboarding & resume
journeys.trigger: User launches before setup state is complete, or reopens setup.
journeys.actions: Review legal gate; request permissions; install/select models; activate license or skip; continue/back/finish; state is loaded and saved per step.
journeys.observable_outcome: Progress/completed/skipped and legal acceptance persist; finish/skip callback runs only after successful save; failures display.
service_dependencies: SettingsBackend; PermissionsBackend; ModelsBackend; optional LicenseBackend; optional app-owned LegalReceiptPort; callbacks.

journeys.title: Media playback
journeys.trigger: User opens audio/video, presses play, seeks, changes speed/volume, or playback decode fails.
journeys.actions: Play/pause/replay; seek; adjust speed/volume; optionally prepare compatible media; retry/open original/open OS player.
journeys.observable_outcome: Playback time/state and decode errors update; external-open callback can hand off.
service_dependencies: MediaAdapters resolveSrc/preparePlayback/cancelPlayback/setFullscreen; app owns playback preparation implementation and notification/log hooks.
extended_demands: HTML media element and codec recovery

journeys.title: Image view, edit & export
journeys.trigger: User opens image and selects crop/text/adjustment/sibling navigation.
journeys.actions: Page sibling images; crop or add text; invoke save, print, resource accounting or external notifications.
journeys.observable_outcome: Canvas preview and selected image update; export/print reports saved path or cancellation/failure.

journeys.title: PDF read & navigate
journeys.trigger: User opens PDF in ViewRight or document surface.
journeys.actions: Load bytes/url/loader; page previous/next/jump; zoom/fit/rotate; outline/thumbnails; find and follow safe external links.
journeys.observable_outcome: Read-only page view changes; page count/error/loading/view state emitted to host.
service_dependencies: PdfSource supplied by host; optional openExternal adapter; host may persist PdfViewState.

journeys.title: Legal agreement & re-acceptance
journeys.trigger: Missing/outdated accepted version opens gate; user reads documents and chooses eligibility basis.
journeys.actions: Open terms/privacy URLs or callbacks; select individual/enterprise; agree or quit.
journeys.observable_outcome: Agree callback records version/hash/timestamp/basis; save failures remain visible; newer version can re-prompt.
service_dependencies: App-owned acceptance receipt is truth when injected; onboarding SettingsBackend stores progress; external URL opener optional.

journeys.title: Keyboard shortcuts & rebinding
journeys.trigger: User presses configured chord, ? help chord, or opens shortcuts settings.
journeys.actions: Dispatch chords/sequences with typing-target guard; open help; expose effective chords and rebinding override.
journeys.observable_outcome: Command runs or remains unhandled; help lists visible active bindings; override state reflected.
service_dependencies: ShortcutRegistry; platform resolver; persistence adapter for overrides supplied by app/settings integration.

journeys.title: Native menu, tray & deep links
journeys.trigger: Native menu/tray/deep-link action arrives with registered id.
journeys.actions: Subscribe to AppShellBridge.onMenuAction; dispatch matching command or shortcut id.
journeys.observable_outcome: Registered action executes in app shell. Actual tray/menu construction and OS lifecycle not specified by these package sources.
service_dependencies: Optional AppShellBridge.onMenuAction; host Tauri menu/tray/deep-link adapters.

journeys.title: Confirm, prompt, palette & help overlays
journeys.trigger: App requests confirmation/prompt, or user opens command/help overlay.
journeys.actions: Present queued dialog; submit/cancel; dismiss via Escape/backdrop; focus trap; select/rank command.
journeys.observable_outcome: Promise resolves true/false or string/null; palette command runs after close; focus is returned/managed.
service_dependencies: ShellProvider dialog and command state; app supplies command callback.

journeys.title: Shell & app state persistence
journeys.trigger: User changes theme/settings/onboarding progress or edits SliceApp rows.
journeys.actions: Theme store reads/writes choice; SettingsBackend stores settings; onboarding patches progress; SliceApp model persists edits.
journeys.observable_outcome: Choice and app state reload from their designated store; SliceApp row edits/ordering are serialized. Storage ownership differs per feature.
service_dependencies: ThemeStorage/localStorage default; SettingsBackend/rightkit-settings; app-owned LegalReceiptPort; SliceApp RowStore (source evidence only).

journeys.title: Check, install & recover update
journeys.trigger: User opens ViewRight Updates settings or install previously downloaded update.
journeys.actions: Check for updates; toggle auto-check; install/download external; on failure retry; protect dirty PDF before replacement.
journeys.observable_outcome: State changes through checking/current/available/installing/failure; dirty document blocks unsafe replacement with error.
service_dependencies: ViewRight update/license service and OS package replacement; dirty-document recovery guard.

journeys.title: Error & startup recovery
journeys.trigger: A component fails or startup/update detects a recoverable state.
journeys.actions: ErrorBoundary exposes recovery action; onboarding load failure offers Retry; update gate may preserve unsaved document.
journeys.observable_outcome: Retry clears boundary or reloads setup; recovery must not discard dirty edits. Package evidence covers only those explicit paths.
service_dependencies: React error boundary; settings loader; app document saver/update recovery services.

journeys.title: SliceApp sample reorderable editor
journeys.trigger: User inserts, edits, moves or deletes a row.
journeys.actions: Focus row; edit text; insert above; nudge up/down or drag reorder; delete.
journeys.observable_outcome: Rows visibly update and model persists edits; sample exercises shared SwiftUI/SwiftRight view source.
